pages.text: The sky was turning dark and gray. Cane the Weather Dog looked up and sniffed the air. "Something is coming," said Cane. "A thunderstorm!" A thunderstorm has three things. First, big dark clouds.
pages.ask: Can you point up high, like you're looking at a tall cloud?

pages.text: Then — FLASH! — came the lightning. Lightning is a giant spark of electricity in the sky. It is bright and fast.
Then — BOOM! — came the thunder. Thunder is the sound that lightning makes.
pages.ask: Can you make a soft "boom" sound?

pages.text: Cane was not scared. Cane was smart. He knew exactly what to do. "When thunder roars," said Cane, "we go indoors!" Cane trotted inside where it was warm and dry. He waited for the storm to pass. He knew to stay inside until the thunder was gone for a long time.
Soon the clouds floated away. The sun peeked out. Cane wagged his tail. "Great job, weather helper," said Cane. "You know what to do when thunder roars. You are weather-ready!"
